title: Mall Dreams
content: I’ve been here lots of times. There is a mall, it snakes itself like a never ending building with shops in it. There is a food court, bookstore and a ladies clothing store. It’s like I’m following someone and there is a level two that you can either walk up an escalator or climb up spiral staircases. Or you can just fly up there. There is an underground where the doors are like old school elevators, only they don’t actually work right. They look like they are painted matte black. There is an underground and a parking garage, but it has many levels that skip levels and is hard to get back in the mall. There is a school and I see biology stuff on the 2nd floor and classrooms and offices on the 3rd floor. There are specimen tanks for swamp-like animals. There is an airport and you can access it without being hindered by chain link fences or security. I can’t describe the airplanes for some reason. There is also a movie theater. Like a big 2 story auditorium with seat steps to the stage. There is a podium that is either center stage, left on the floor or right on the floor. Everyone has a chance to speak or play music or videos. I’ve been there looking for rare lego sets forever. Also, the upstairs food court is always closed for some reason.
